chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) who said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was brought a watermelon and fresh dates, so he ate from both of them and said, 'These are the two most delightful [foods].'

key_terms.رُطَبٍ: Fresh dates (dates in the ripening stage)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about watermelon and fresh dates?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this narration underscores the Prophet’s (S) preference for simple, natural sustenance, linking the sweetness of watermelon and fresh dates to spiritual and physical purity. In Shia tradition, this aligns with the broader prophetic emphasis on moderation and the virtue of consuming foods that are both wholesome and easily digestible, reflecting a holistic approach to health and spirituality.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-143 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, “
They brought watermelon and dates for the Prophet (S). He ate of both of them and said, ‘These are delightful.’”
